IdasBand.description:
Explicit half-bandwidths in the original admitted state ordering.
Zero retains only the diagonal on that side; no ordering is inferred.

lower.description: Number of original state columns retained below a row's diagonal.

upper.description: Number of original state columns retained above a row's diagonal.

IdasInitialConditionsOutput.description: Exact IDAS consistent-initialization controls; no physical time stepping is requested.

backtracks.description: Explicit maximum backtracks per Newton step, when line search is enabled.

jacobian_attempts.description: Maximum Jacobian setup attempts at each artificial scale.

newton_iterations.description: Maximum Newton iterations at each setup attempt.

step_tolerance.description: Positive scaled Newton-step floor for constraints and the enabled line search.

step_trials.description: Maximum attempted artificial step scales; applies only to AlgebraicAndRates.

IdasInitialStep.description:
Origin of the first physical IDAS step; consistent initialization retains its
separate positive orientation scale in [`Profile::initial_step`].

oneOf.description: Attempt the positive step in the shared dynamic profile.
Let the native integrator estimate its first physical step (the default).
SuiteSparse KLU over the compiled analytic Jacobian.
Matrix-free GMRES over analytic Jacobian-vector products.

preconditioner.description: Left preconditioner built from the compiled Jacobian; none when absent.

oneOf.description:
Exact matrix-free GMRES with the native library's band approximation as
a left preconditioner. Both bands name original state coordinates.

difference.description: Envelope used by native grouped residual differences.

retained.description: Band of the approximation retained and factored by IDAS.

oneOf.description: Matrix-free flexible GMRES over analytic Jacobian-vector products.

preconditioner.description: Left preconditioner built from the compiled Jacobian; none when absent.

PositiveCount.description: A strictly positive count: a dimension, a thread count or an iteration budget.

description:
Typed IDAS-only method controls (ADR-0110 item 1), a versioned boundary document
(ADR-0116 Outcome 6): the version is required, and absent fields take these defaults.
Version 2 removes the per-state sign constraints: they derive from the authored bounds
([`Contract::signs`], ADR-0119 Outcome 4).
Version 3 makes native automatic first-step selection the default (ADR-0207).

initial_conditions.description: Public IDACalcIC phase controls, also applied to scheduled consistent restarts.

initialization.description:
Consistent initialization at the start of the horizon; scheduled changes and resets
always keep their differential states.

native_initial_step.description: Native first-step policy, independent of the positive IC orientation scale.
